en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a historical building's courtyard, likely from a cloister or college. The view is framed by a large archway, looking onto a lush garden surrounded by a two-story arcade with arches and windows. In the background, elaborate towers and a clock tower are visible, indicating a significant and monumental structure. The text at the bottom references Santiago de Compostela and the Colegio Fonseca (Faculty of Medicine).
